async def act(page):
    # Select the 'express' template by filtering the radio button based on the associated 'Preview' link
    express_radio = page.get_by_role('radio', name='Use template').filter(has=page.get_by_role('link', name='Preview', url='*express*'))

    # Wait for the UI to update after template selection
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
